name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: per-tick (_tick_) summon-spell animation (_summon_anim_) state machine, variant C of several summon animations (_variant_c_, semantic discriminator), 5 ring slots (_5slot_, the i<5 loops and 5-entry x/y/frame/blit arrays -- a meaningful array dimension, not an address), placing sprites at radial positions via sin/cos (_radial). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x26e39 or any data address). Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Per-tick state machine for the variant-C 5-slot radial summon-spell animation: drives a 5-sprite ring whose slot positions are computed from sin/cos of a per-slot angle scaled by a ring-radius accumulator, blitting the ring across an open/close sequence with per-slot staggered frame counters and SFX cues.
logic_summary: Allocates 0x6C stack frame (__CHK). Copies the 5x u32 offset table (0x524F8 = {10,8,3,0,0}) into local offs[] and the 5-byte byte_offsets (0x5250C = {10,8,3,0,0}) into local byte_offs[]. Reads caster team from runtime_char_array[caster_unit_id].bTeam: team 0 (enemy) sets sweep=0x5A and negates offs[0..2] / zeros byte_offs[0..2]; otherwise sweep=0x1E. Dispatches on state_code: 0=INIT (SFX bank id2, reset angle_accumulator=0 and swap_done_latch=0, return 7); 3=TRANSITION one-shot guarded by swap_done_latch (seed frame_counter[i]=-i, clear blit_counter[i], swap x[2]<->x[4], copy y[2]=y[4], y[4]=angle_accumulator, set latch, return 0xC); 6=reset angle_accumulator=0x2A + SFX bank id3, return 7; 1/2/7/8=RADIAL-BLIT (per slot i: angle_rad = (float)(i*0x48 deg)*pi/180 promoted to double; x[i]=round(sweep+acc*cos), y[i]=round(acc*sin*1.2+30.0); blit gated by team and state -- enemy blits on 2/8, player/ally blits on 1/7 for i<2 and on 2/8 for i>=2; then state 2 ramps acc +6 (open ring), state 8 ramps -6 (close ring); return 0); 4/5=PER-SLOT BLIT+ADVANCE (per slot, scratch sprite-id = frame_counter<0 ? 4 : (byte)frame_counter; if id==1 seed blit_counter=5; blit gated by team/state using offs[id]/byte_offs[id]; for state 5 only a post-loop pass advances blit_counter 1..9 wrapping at 10 with a trailing-sprite blit, fires SFX on frame 0 (handle path for i in {0,2}, sample path otherwise except i==5), advances frame_counter wrapping 5->0, sets done_flag when frame_counter hits 2; returns done_flag, state 4 returns 0); any other state_code returns 0.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 sprite_handle, uint32 origin_y, uint32 row_stride, uint32 state_code)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr; only its .bTeam byte (offset 6) is read to choose enemy vs player/ally sweep and offset polarity.
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime-character index; no address residue.

params.name: sprite_handle
params.semantics: Sprite/atlas handle passed as the first argument to every fd2_blit_indexed_sprite call.
params.reason: Accurately names the blit sprite handle; no address residue.

params.name: origin_y
params.semantics: Base framebuffer offset added to the per-slot computed coordinate (y*row_stride + x + origin_y) before blitting; the destination origin for the ring.
params.reason: No address residue; this is the family-wide parameter name shared by every summon-animation tick in anisummn.c (same (caster,sprite,origin_y,row_stride,state) signature). Keeping preserves family consistency; renaming a single member would be inconsistent and is out of scope.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Framebuffer row pitch: multiplies the y-coordinate to form a linear offset and is passed as the stride argument to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite.
params.reason: Accurately names the row pitch; no address residue.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Animation state-machine selector (0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8) chosen by the dispatch table caller; selects INIT / radial-blit / per-slot-blit / transition phases.
params.reason: Accurately names the state selector; no address residue. (Ghidra types it as byte; src widens to uint32 -- a type-equivalent declaration choice, not a naming concern.)

returns.semantics: Per-tick scheduling/wait value: 7 (INIT/state6 wait), 0xC (transition wait), or 0 for the blit phases; in state 5 returns done_flag (1 once any slot frame_counter reaches 2, else 0) to signal the animation finished. Unhandled state_code returns 0.
